extra.summary: The HSBC Advance Credit Card is best suited for individuals with consistent monthly spending, especially those who can reliably spend over S$2,000 to unlock the higher 2.5% cashback rate. The base 1.5% cashback on all purchases offers a no-fuss way to earn rewards on everyday spending. While the S$70 monthly cap limits earning potential for high spenders, access to ENTERTAINER with HSBC provides 1-for-1 dining and lifestyle deals, adding significant value if actively utilized.
badges: Earn up to 2.5% Cashback | Instant Activation*

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
(a) Singaporeans, Singapore Permanent Residents: SGD 65,000 OR 
 (b) Singapore Citizens / Permanent Residents with HSBC total relationship balance (“TRB”)* of at least SGD50,000: SGD 30,000 for salaried employees 
 SGD 40,000 for self-employed or commission-based (*Total Relationship Balance (TRB) refers to the total value of your deposits, investments, and insurance with HSBC Bank (Singapore) Limited, calculated based on the average monthly balance over the last 3 months.)

our_takes.our-take: The HSBC Advance Credit Card is best suited for individuals with consistent monthly spending, especially those who can reliably spend over S$2,000 to unlock the higher 2.5% cashback rate. The base 1.5% cashback on all purchases offers a no-fuss way to earn rewards on everyday spending. While the S$70 monthly cap limits earning potential for high spenders, access to ENTERTAINER with HSBC provides 1-for-1 dining and lifestyle deals, adding significant value if actively utilized. Consider alternatives if your spending is heavily concentrated in specific categories like groceries or petrol.
our_takes.good-for:
Individuals who spend over S$2,000 monthly and want higher cashback rates on all local and overseas purchases.
Homeowners seeking fuss-free cashback on everyday expenses like groceries, utilities, and online shopping with automated crediting. 
MoneySmart users who appreciate retail and dining deals while earning cashback on daily online, retail, and dining transactions.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Cashback is capped at SGD70/month; spending over SGD2,000 still limits rewards.
26.9% APR on balances can lead to significant interest charges if unpaid.
SGD100 late payment fee applies, so be sure to pay on time to avoid it.
